definitions.explanation: Fighting or competition at very close range, where opponents are in direct physical proximity. Used in military, sports, and gaming contexts.

examples.japanese: {接近戦|せっきんせん}に{持|も}ち{込|こ}む。
このゲームでは{接近戦|せっきんせん}が{得意|とくい}なキャラクターを{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: In this game, I chose a character who is good at close-range combat.

examples.japanese: {接近戦|せっきんせん}では{体格|たいかく}の{大|おお}きい{選手|せんしゅ}が{有利|ゆうり}だが、{技術|ぎじゅつ}で{補|おぎな}うこともできる。
examples.english: In close-range fights, larger athletes have an advantage, but it can be compensated for with technique.

notes:
Composed of {接近|せっきん} (approach, proximity) and {戦|せん} (battle, fight).

Widely used in gaming contexts to describe melee combat as opposed to ranged combat. Also used figuratively in competitive contexts like elections or sports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {接近戦|せっきんせん}に{持|も}ち{込|こ}む (to force into close combat)
- {接近戦|せっきんせん}に{強|つよ}い (strong at close range)
- {接近戦|せっきんせん}を{挑|いど}む (to engage in close combat)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {接近戦|せっきんせん}: close-quarters combat (general)
- {白兵戦|はくへいせん}: hand-to-hand combat (military, with weapons)
- {肉弾戦|にくだんせん}: hand-to-hand fight (emphasis on physical contact)
